blocks.html:
GTALx – The Event

Thanks to Mopar for organizing the GTALx event.
Below are some of the amazing shots that we got from the event. Thanks to everyone who came to the event and helped make the GTALx so interesting!
Our installer wrapped this vehicle live during the show using 3M Wrap Film Series 1080 and Avery Dennison Supreme Wrapping Film to showcase how we wrap the vehicle.
We applied 3M Wrap Film on the green and orange side and we applied Avery Dennison Supreme Wrapping Film on the Black Side of the Truck.
We choose to use only 3M Wrapping material and Avery Dennison material because they are premium wrapping material and they last a long time and do not damage easily.

If ever you need a Car Wrap, Van Wrap, Truck Wrap, or even a Plane Wrap – We do it all! From Vehicle Graphics to Equipment Graphics, we can wrap everything that you can imagine. We are here to offer guaranteed satisfaction from design to implementation of the wrap!
